newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daishowa Paper's 97/98 profit to fall 59 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Daishowa Paper's 97/98 profit to fall 59 pct - paper.

text.p: Daishowa Paper Manufacturing Co Ltd is expected to see its parent current profit fall 59 percent to 6.5 billion yen in the year to March 1998, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Tuesday.
The decline in profit is mainly due to deteriorating conditions in the paper market and the weak yen, the paper said.
The company is likely to continue to suspend dividend payouts in 1997/98, the paper said.
A company spokesman declined to comment on the report.
